name: @rbee/queen-rbee-sdk
description: Rust SDK for queen-rbee that compiles to WASM for browser/Node.js usage

scripts.build: node -e "process.env.RBEE_SKIP_WASM === '1' ? console.log('Skipping wasm-pack build (RBEE_SKIP_WASM=1)') : process.exit(1)" || RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir pkg/bundler

author: rbee Team
